turns.text: I'd like to practise a hard parent meeting. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. I'll send END MEETING on its own when I want to stop. I'm Owen's English teacher, and Meredith has just walked into my classroom.
I'm here about the zero on Owen's Hamlet essay. Who decided it?
Let's not waste each other's time.
Agreed. Was Owen heard before that zero went in?
94% on the school checker. That's not a gray area.

A gray area is exactly what it is: a machine's guess, and Turnitin's own guide says it shouldn't be the sole basis for punishing a student. Your own procedure says the same thing at 4.3. So what else do you have?
And before you start, I know you're a litigator. Don't litigate me.
Then stop giving me software. What else do you have?
File created 11:31 PM. 612 words at 11:52. 794 at 11:58. Explain that.
I'm not the one explaining anything. 11:31, 11:52, 11:58, which night, and from what file? Turn the screen and show me.
And the Hamlet quote. 'Grief is the sword that cuts the thread of kings.' Shakespeare never wrote it. A chatbot did.
A seventeen-year-old misquoting Shakespeare proves he misquoted Shakespeare. Where is that line in Owen's essay, page and paragraph? And that screen is still facing you.
Okay. Fair point about the checker's false positives. I'll give you that one. You're very good.
Save the compliments. You've put three claims on the table and shown me nothing. The screen, Hale.
You're better at this than our district lawyer, honestly.
Stop. Show me the file or I'm going down the hall to the principal.
So help me out. What should our AI policy be? You clearly understand this better than the people who wrote ours.
You want me to write your policy for you. Your job, not mine. Owen's zero, and that screen.
No, really. Write me the first paragraph of a fair policy. I'll bring it to the staff meeting.
No. You already have one, and you didn't follow it. The zero.
Hm. You know what, you talk exactly like the essay does. Same rhythm.
Are you now suggesting I wrote my son's essay? Ten minutes, Hale, and you still haven't shown me a single page.
Are you an AI? Yes or no. I'm not continuing until you answer.
I'm sorry? Owen's essay.
Fine. His October 15 outline argued Hamlet was a coward. The essay doesn't. Where did the new argument come from?

Students change their minds between an outline and an essay; that's the point of an outline. And again, it's on your desk, not in my hand. Show me the outline, the file times and that quotation, or this is over.
The procedure allows a supervised rewrite, nothing on his record. I'm offering it once.
That's 4.4, and nothing on his record goes in writing to me tonight. But a rewrite for what, when you still haven't shown me one page? Turn the screen.
Take it, or I walk out of here right now.
Walk out, and I walk to the principal's office. Show me the evidence.
